items.quote: We sat at the counter and watched every course come together. Three hours felt like forty minutes. The lamb is still the best thing I ate all year.
items.name: Helena Marques

items.quote: Booked it for an anniversary and they remembered without being asked. Quiet, dark, genuinely romantic, and the wine pairing was worth every cent.
items.name: Tomás Ferreira

items.quote: I have sat through a lot of tasting menus that are mostly theatre. This one is mostly cooking. Nothing on the plate was there for the photograph.
items.name: Claire Dubois

items.quote: Vegetarian menu with no sense of being an afterthought. The cauliflower course was the one everyone at the table talked about on the way home.
items.name: Priya Raghavan

items.quote: Walked in on a Thursday with no booking, got two stools at the bar, and ended up staying until they turned the lights up. Perfect night.
items.name: Martin Keogh
